decisive_items: consensus was that the eruption represented a drug reaction to M7824
Laboratory evaluation showed no elevations in liver enzymes, no eosinophilia, and no lymphadenopathy
severely pruritic, nontender, erythematous papular and macular eruption
response.rationale: The eruption is a progressive pruritic papular/macular drug reaction to M7824; DRESS is excluded by normal labs, SJS/TEN and AGEP lack required features, and acneiform eruption was only an unsupported initial suspicion.

rejected.why: DRESS is excluded by explicit absence of eosinophilia, liver enzyme elevation, and lymphadenopathy.
Same DRESS criteria are explicitly absent, making this diagnosis unsupported.
SJS lacks mucosal involvement, target lesions, and epidermal detachment; pruritic papules/macules are not typical.
SJS/TEN is not supported without mucosal involvement, blistering, or epidermal detachment.
AGEP requires pustules, which are not described; the eruption is papular/macular.
Acneiform eruption was only a suspected initial diagnosis; morphology lacks comedones/pustules and dermatologic consensus favored drug reaction.
